fixes_exercised.posix_process_job: adapter starts Hermes via session_exec.py (setsid); shutdown froze and killed the session tree; native_turns.process_closed=1 for both operations

loop.io_wait_answer_host_timeout: first wait hit the Hermes 420 s tool timeout before the user answered; the model checked status and waited again

not_achieved.why: the question-only profile deliberately exposes no file or terminal tools (restricted_profile.py: production tool enrollment is a separate decision). The test prompt asked for a file, so Hermes could only report the answer.
not_achieved.why_unknown: after receiving the answer the model opened a stray question '（内部探测，请忽略）' and ended its turn; the scheduler withdrew it and conservatively recorded unanswered_question_at_native_completion, so no result message reached the phone
